answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 49876 Country: India Title: regardind selling of Flat Question: If I sell my flat to a person and he wants to purchase my flat on loan on that flat. The amount which I get after selling my flat to that person is jayez or najayez? Answer ID: 49876 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 185/155/B=03/1435) As purchasing flat in cash is lawful, in the same way purchasing flat on loan is lawful and valid. But you cannot charge extra payment after maturity of the debt period except what was mutually agreed upon. Charging extra amount will be considered as interest. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
